slides.headline: POV: your first viewing is Saturday
slides.body: Five jobs to do this week. Save this.

slides.headline: Fix the small things
slides.body: Dripping taps, loose handles, blown globes. Buyers notice every one.

slides.headline: Clear every surface
slides.body: Counters, tables and shelves. Less stuff makes every room look bigger.

slides.headline: Let the light in
slides.body: Clean the windows and open every curtain before buyers arrive.

slides.headline: Tidy the way in
slides.body: Sweep the path, trim the garden and clean the front door.

slides.headline: Get your paperwork ready
slides.body: Plans, guarantees and certificates. Ask early what you will need.

slides.headline: Get your home ready to sell
slides.body: A free market analysis of your home, plus my get-your-home-ready checklist.
